name: Feeds for Pinterest – Turn Your Boards into a Beautiful Gallery
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Turn your Pinterest boards into a fresh, responsive photo gallery on your WordPress site – just enter a username and board name.

Live Demo | Buy Premium | Support

Why Feeds for Pinterest?

Your Pinterest boards are full of content your visitors would love – but only if they see it. Feeds for Pinterest retrieves the latest pins from a specified Pinterest board and displays them as a photo gallery on any page or widget, keeping your site visually fresh without any manual work.

The plugin comes with an easy configuration panel and a shortcode generator, so coders and non-coders alike can build unique Pinterest feeds with responsive layouts and customizable styles. Just provide your Pinterest username, board name, and a template – the plugin does the rest.

It is lightweight, minimalist, RTL-ready, compatible with any theme, and outputs Schema.org-compliant JSON-LD markup optimized for speed.

Free Features

  • Fully Responsive: Mobile-friendly galleries on every screen size.
  • Shortcode Generator: Build feeds through an intuitive admin UI.
  • Unlimited Feeds: Add as many Pinterest feeds as you want.
  • Easy Styling: Simple options to customize and stylize your galleries.
  • User-Friendly Settings: A settings panel built for coders and non-coders alike.
  • RTL Ready: Works with right-to-left languages out of the box.
  • Theme Compatible: Works with any WordPress theme.
  • SEO & Speed Friendly: Schema.org-compliant JSON-LD markup, optimized for performance.
  • Browser Support: Works in all modern browsers – Firefox, Chrome, IE, Safari, and more.

Pro Version

Upgrade to Premium for more layouts and design control:

  • Show/Hide Pins: Curate exactly which pins appear.
  • Four Layouts: Default, Masonry, Slider, and Justified.
  • Image Ratio: Change the image ratio to fit your design.
  • Popup Options: Show or hide Zoom In, Zoom Out, Toggle 1:1, and more.
  • Overlay Styling: Set image overlay, transform, and overlay color.
  • Typography Controls: Style the Name, About, Count, and button text.

How to Use – Quick Start

  1. Install and activate the plugin – a Pinterest menu appears in your admin panel.
  2. Open the menu and configure a new feed with your Pinterest username, board name, and a template.
  3. Copy the generated shortcode.
  4. Paste the shortcode into any page, post, or widget and publish.

Use Cases

  • Bloggers & Creators: Showcase your latest pins alongside your posts.
  • Shops & Makers: Display product inspiration boards to potential customers.
  • Portfolios: Turn a curated board into an always-updated image gallery.
  • Community Sites: Keep pages fresh with regularly updated Pinterest content.

This plugin is actively being developed and improved. If there’s a feature you want but we don’t have yet, please let us know.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Feeds for Pinterest”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Open the Pinterest menu in your admin panel to configure your first feed.

Manual installation:

  1. Download b-pinterest-feed.zip.
  2. In your admin area, go to Plugins → Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the zip file from your computer and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How do I display a Pinterest feed on my site?

Create a feed from the Pinterest menu in your admin panel by entering your Pinterest username, board name, and a template. Then paste the generated shortcode into any page, post, or widget.

Can I add more than one Pinterest feed?

Yes. You can add unlimited Pinterest feeds, each with its own board and settings.

Does the plugin work with my theme?

Yes. The plugin is compatible with any WordPress theme and is fully responsive, so galleries look great on desktop and mobile.

What layouts are available?

The free version displays your pins as a photo gallery using the default layout. The Pro version adds Masonry, Slider, and Justified layouts, plus image ratio, overlay, popup, and typography controls.

Where can I get support?

If you find any issue or need help, please ask us in the WordPress.org Support Forum.
